title: Juicy Fresh Croatian Beet Salad
description: This Croatian beet salad is a fresh and fluffy crowd-pleaser featuring beets and a coconut cream crack, perfect for any occasion
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Wrap the beets in foil and roast for 45 minutes, or until tender.
Let the beets cool, then peel and dice them.
In a blender, combine the coconut cream, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
In a large bowl, combine the diced beets, coconut cream mixture, and chopped parsley.
Toss the salad to combine, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
